description:
The plot illustrates the count of different types of responses generated by various models. The x-axis is labeled "Model" and has a linear scale, ranging from an unlabeled starting point to "Mistral 7B", with a single tick label at each model name. The y-axis is labeled "Count" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 120, with tick labels at intervals of 20. 

The line representing "Type1" is colored teal and displays a count of approximately 24 at the beginning of the x-axis, increasing to approximately 108 at "Mistral 7B". The line representing "Type2" is colored salmon and shows a count of approximately 36 at the beginning of the x-axis, increasing to approximately 102 at "Mistral 7B". The line representing "RR" is colored plum and displays a count of approximately 28 at the beginning of the x-axis, increasing to approximately 32 at "Mistral 7B". The line representing "WW" is colored light green and shows a count of approximately 30 at the beginning of the x-axis, increasing to approximately 28 at "Mistral 7B".
